description: Global spell/ability records. Established by EXP-0026: the $C46AC0 14-byte record table (CEN-BATTLE-0004) doubles as the spell database — records 0-53 are the 54 magic spells (count Confirmed by the name-table boundary, EXP-0027), ids shared with the 7-byte name table at ROMFILE:0x26F567 (CEN-MAGIC-0003). Names decode via the fixed-font byte encoding (CEN-MENU-0006). Bulk name text stays in local artifacts per docs/legal/ASSET_POLICY.md; this inventory stores ids, offsets, numbers, flags, and observation-sourced display names only. Names are decoded from the ROM name table by `ff6lab extract data` and are policy-permitted in Git (docs/legal/ASSET_POLICY.md); the full raw records live in the local archive.

fields.byte2: flags: bit0 physical formula, bit7 MP-path dispatch (Confirmed)
fields.byte3: bit7 MP retarget (Confirmed); other bits unknown
fields.byte4: mode: bit7 base variant, bit1 flip chain, bit0 party halving (Confirmed)
fields.byte5: MP cost (Confirmed for id 45: menu readout + '5 MP Needed' targeting text + live deduction 24->19, EXP-0026/0027; other ids extracted, per-id on-screen verification pending)
fields.byte9: flag byte, ASL post-processed (Confirmed loader-side; semantics unknown)

availability.wram: +$1A6E + 54*character_slot (54 bytes per character, $FF = known; stride beyond slot 0 is a hypothesis)
